features.description: CI/CD con Playwright E2E, pre-commit hooks
features.evidence: lint 0 errors (astro check + tsc), build 0 errors (astro build 12.39s), test:unit 76 suites 587 PASS, validate 0 failures, husky pre-commit ok, validate-secrets PASS (root). Workflows disabled intencional GitCore private era.
features.caveat: 72->85 honesto: vitest ya verde local; Actions disabled es correcto para private era.

features.description: Limpieza de secrets expuestos en git history + hardening
features.evidence: PRs #961/#964 merged + sanitize + ALLOWED_ORIGINS fix + validate-secrets.sh PASS + scripts/security-221-history-rewrite.sh (dry-run OK, sin force-push sin coordinacion).
features.caveat: Código hardening 90% completo. History rewrite (git-filter-repo + force-push) documentado en .gitcore/planning/SECURITY_221_PREP.md y docs/SECURITY.md pero no ejecutado (requiere coordinación). No inflar a 100 hasta push coordinado.
features.notes: Security hardening: secrets cleanup, SQL injection protection, XSS detection, input validation. PRs #961, #964.
